probe.text: Speculative decoding works by having a small draft model propose a sequence of tokens, then the target model verifies them in parallel. Each proposed token is accepted with probability min(1, p(x)/q(x)), where p is the target model's probability and q is the draft model's. If a token is rejected, the next token is drawn from the residual distribution (p(x) − q(x)) normalized, which is exactly the rejection-sampling procedure. Because rejection sampling is a mathematically exact method for sampling from p using q as a proposal, the final output distribution is identical to what the target model would have produced on its own, token for token.

**Diary — 2026-02-14 — Porting the CUDA engine to HIP on gfx906**

Today I finished the first end-to-end port of our CUDA compute engine to HIP on an AMD Vega 10 / gfx906 device. The engine is a small tile-based kernel pipeline: load input tiles into shared memory, run a fused reduction, write results back through a stream-ordered pipeline. The CUDA version had been tuned for 32-lane warps, so the main work was not just renaming APIs, but rethinking warp-level code for 64-lane wavefronts.

---

## 1. Environment

Target device:

```bash
$ rocminfo | grep -A 10 "gfx906"
Name:                    gfx906
Marketing Name:          Radeon Instinct MI60
Compute Unit:            64
Max Work Group Size:     1024
LDS Size:                65536 bytes
```

Compiler:

```bash
$ hipcc --version
hipcc version 6.1.40500-...
```

Build command:

```bash
hipcc -O3 -x hip \
  --offload-arch=gfx906 \
  -Iinclude \
  -o engine_hip \
  src/engine_hip.cpp \
  src/kernels_hip.cpp
```

I explicitly targeted `gfx906` because the default fat binary was pulling in `gfx908` and `gfx90a` code paths, and I wanted a clean ISA for profiling.

---

## 2. API translation

The CUDA engine used:

```cpp
cudaMalloc
cudaMemcpyAsync
cudaStreamCreate
cudaEventCreate
cudaEventRecord
cudaEventSynchronize
cudaDeviceSynchronize
```

```cpp
hipMalloc
hipMemcpyAsync
hipStreamCreate
hipEventCreate
hipEventRecord
hipEventSynchronize
hipDeviceSynchronize
```

```cpp
kernel<<<grid, block, sharedMemBytes, stream>>>(args);
```
